blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala tries to snap out of her slump at the Ningbo Open in China next week. Eala is 0-3 in her last three matches on Tour, including upset losses to unheralded opponents in unseeded Russian Tatiana Prozorova at the Singapore Open round of 16 late last month and Chinese qualifier Shi Han at the Wuhan Open round of 64 on Monday. The Wuhan Open, the last WTA 1000 event of the season, marked Eala’s return on Tour after she skipped the China Open in Beijing to represent the Philippines at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in Japan.
